Hi Esteban.
Thanks a lot for reviewing my presentation slides.
Your comments were helpful.
No problem.
I think your presentation will go really well.
Thanks.
I spent a lot of time over the weekend working on it.
I hope your weekend was better than mine.
Oh, mine was pretty good.
I went to a cooking class at a restaurant downtown and learned how to modify recipes to make them healthier.
That sounds interesting.
Which restaurant hosted the class?
I'd like to see if they have any more coming up.
It's called Henderson's Cafe.
I'll send you a link to their website.

希望你的周末比我好。

我去市中心一家餐厅上了一堂烹饪课，学了如何修改食谱使其更健康。
听起来很有趣。
是哪家餐厅举办的课程？
我想看看他们是否还有其他课程。
它叫Henderson's Cafe。
我把他们的网站链接发给你。
